# Angel Cables — R K Enterprises

> Angel Cables is a leading manufacturer and supplier of ISI-certified electrical wires and cables based in Delhi, India. Established in 2005, we supply contractors, builders, dealers and industrial buyers across India. Direct from factory pricing with bulk order support.

## About

Angel Cables (a unit of R K Enterprises) has been manufacturing high-quality electrical wires and cables since 2005 from our factory at Lawrence Road Industrial Area, Delhi. All products are ISI-marked and meet Indian electrical safety standards.

## Products

- [Armoured Cable](https://angelcables.com/products?category=Armoured%20Cable): Steel wire armoured (SWA) cables for underground and industrial use. Available in 2C, 3.5C and 4C variants in both aluminium and copper conductors. Sizes 1.5 to 300 sq mm. IS 1554 certified.
- [Electric House Wire](https://angelcables.com/products?category=Electric%20House%20Wire): FR (Flame Retardant) and FRLS (Flame Retardant Low Smoke) PVC insulated copper conductor house wiring cables. Single core and multi-strand variants. Sizes 1.0 to 6.0 sq mm. IS 694 certified.
- [Flexible Cable](https://angelcables.com/products?category=Flexible%20Cable): Multi-strand flexible copper cables for appliances and industrial equipment. Includes shielded control cables for EMI-sensitive applications.
- [CCTV Cables](https://angelcables.com/products?category=CCTV%20Cables): RG-6 coaxial cables (CCS and pure copper), and 1+3, 1+4, 1+6 combo power+video cables for CCTV surveillance systems.
- [Submersible Cable](https://angelcables.com/products?category=Submersible%20Cable): Waterproof cables for submersible pumps and borewell applications. Single-phase (1.5, 2.5 sq mm) and three-phase (4, 6 sq mm) variants.
- [Copper Wire](https://angelcables.com/products?category=Copper%20Wire): Bare copper wire, tinned copper wire, and EC-grade earthing wire for electrical and industrial use. Sizes 0.5 to 50 sq mm.
- [CAT6 & LAN Cables](https://angelcables.com/products?category=CAT6%20%26%20LAN%20Cables): CAT6 UTP cables (305mtr and 90mtr boxes), CAT6 outdoor armoured cable, and CAT5e UTP cables for Gigabit Ethernet and structured network cabling.
- [Telephone & Communication Cable](https://angelcables.com/products?category=Telephone%20%26%20Communication%20Cable): TCBC telephone wire, 2-pair, 4-pair, and multi-pair (10/20 pair) cables for EPABX systems, intercom networks and telephone infrastructure.

## Guides & Blog

- [Wiring Guides](https://angelcables.com/blog): Expert articles on electrical wiring for Indian homes and projects
- [Which Wire for Air Conditioner? Complete Guide](https://angelcables.com/blog/which-wire-for-air-conditioner-india): Wire sizing for 1 ton, 1.5 ton and 2 ton ACs, copper vs aluminium, FR vs FRLS for AC circuits
- [FR vs FRLS Wire Guide](https://angelcables.com/blog/fr-vs-frls-house-wire-india-guide): Differences between FR and FRLS house wire, which buildings need which grade, ISI certification guide
- [Armoured Cable Guide](https://angelcables.com/blog/armoured-cable-guide-india): SWA vs STA, core configurations, underground installation, sizing guide for Indian applications
- [Submersible Cable for Borewell Guide](https://angelcables.com/blog/submersible-cable-borewell-india): Single vs three phase, sizing by pump HP and depth, what makes a genuine submersible cable
- [Copper vs Aluminium Wire](https://angelcables.com/blog/copper-vs-aluminium-wire-india): Why copper is the correct choice for Indian building wiring, IS 694 standards, CCA wire warning
- [Common House Wiring Mistakes](https://angelcables.com/blog/common-house-wiring-mistakes-india): 8 common Indian wiring mistakes — wrong wire sizes, no earthing, oversized MCBs, non-ISI wire
